remarks: Escape to the outdoors with this mostly wooded 167-acre parcel offering exceptional recreational and hunting opportunities. Accessed by a deeded right-of-way, this secluded property provides the privacy and tranquility that outdoor enthusiasts are looking for. The land features a diverse wooded landscape that has not been recently logged, potentially offering valuable timber resources for future consideration. Whether you're seeking a private hunting retreat, a place to enjoy nature, or a long-term land investment, this expansive property has plenty of potential. Abundant wildlife, mature timber, and a peaceful setting make it an ideal destination for hunting, hiking, camping, and other outdoor activities. Rarely does a tract of this size become available—don't miss the opportunity to own your own piece of the great outdoors. The snowmobile trail borders the property.
